title: Network initiated transport of user data via the control plane

entities.name: Network initiated transport of user data via the control plane
entities.description: Procedure where the network sends user data to the UE via the control plane using the ESM DATA TRANSPORT message.

entities.name: ESM DATA TRANSPORT
entities.description: Message sent by the network to transport user data to the UE via the control plane.

entities.name: User data container
entities.description: Information element containing user data to be forwarded to upper layers in the UE.

entities.name: Forward user data to upper layers
entities.description: Condition where the UE forwards the contents of the User data container IE to upper layers upon receiving the ESM DATA TRANSPORT message.

relations.description: The procedure includes sending the ESM DATA TRANSPORT message.
The ESM DATA TRANSPORT message contains the User data container IE.
The condition specifies that the UE forwards the contents of the User data container IE to upper layers.
